blocks.html:
This method deletes an inventory level associated with an inventory item
and a stock location.

This method sends a request to the
[Remove Inventory Level](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#inventory-items\_deleteinventoryitemsidlocationlevelslocation\_id)
API route.
